description: Read a tournament's roster as structured data: every player's name and stable player_id, in seed order. Pass the tournament's manage_code as code to ALSO receive the registration entries with contact details (email, phone, source); without a valid code only names and ids are returned, matching what the public pages show. Use it to verify the roster after import_players / register_player, or before generate_bracket. Read-only.

code.description: Optional manage_code — unlocks the entries list with contact details

name: get_roster
